Extracts response metadata from HTTP headers (etag, server, content-language)

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.response_meta.etag.inspect
puts result.response_meta.last_modified.inspect
puts result.response_meta.server.inspect
puts result.response_meta.content_language.inspect
```
